The volumes each fraction covers

Source: R/fraction.R
chrom_fractions.Rd

Gives the start and end volume of each fraction in a chromatogram. A fraction starts at the first point collected into it and ends at the first point after it, so the fractions of a run meet end to end. These are the sampled volumes, so they are within one point of the volumes the fraction collector recorded. A fraction collected into more than once, as when the collector runs out of tubes and starts again at the first, has a row for each time.

Usage

chrom_fractions(data)

Arguments

data

A chromatogram from chrom_read_*(), with volume and fraction columns. Appended runs, with a run column, are handled run by run.

Value

A tibble with a row for each fraction and the columns fraction, start and end, and run if data has one.

Examples

fl <- system.file("extdata", "example_akta_2.asc", package = "chromr")
read_akta_old(fl) |>
  chrom_fractions()
#> # A tibble: 73 × 3
#>    fraction start  end
#>      <frac>  <mL> <mL>
#>  1        1  9.11 11.0
#>  2        2 11.0  13.1
#>  3        3 13.1  15.0
#>  4        4 15.0  17.1
#>  5        5 17.1  19.0
#>  6        6 19.0  21.1
#>  7        7 21.1  23.0
#>  8        8 23.0  25.1
#>  9        9 25.1  27.2
#> 10       10 27.2  29.1
#> # ℹ 63 more rows
